name: jevprune
description: Prunes long Bash results per line before the model reads them, and recovers dropped ranges by run id.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

threshold.title: Keep threshold
threshold.description: Minimum Jev score, 0 to 1, for a line to stay visible.

diagnostics.title: Log pruning decisions
diagnostics.description: Log the reason a result was passed through, the line counts and the request count. Never the command or the output.
